output.summary: Rhizomatous flowering perennial native to southern Africa. It has broad, arrow-shaped leaves and a large white sheath surrounding a fragrant yellow flower spike. Eating the raw plant may severely burn and swell the mouth and throat and cause stomach pain and diarrhoea.
output.edibilityNote: The raw plant contains calcium oxalate and may cause severe mouth and throat irritation, stomach pain and diarrhoea.
